packs.title: Country and industry packs
packs.description: Ready-made content for your country and industry: holidays, banks, lists, terms and default settings. You may change any of it; a newer pack never overwrites what you changed.
packs.loadError: The packs could not be loaded.
packs.denied: You may not see the packs.
packs.readOnly: You can look at the packs but not install or upgrade them.
packs.approval: Installs, upgrades and taken pack values wait for a second person's approval.
packs.installed.title: Installed packs
packs.installed.empty.body: Install the country pack of your companies from the list below.
packs.available.title: Packs you can install
packs.available.empty.body: Packs the vendor publishes for your product version appear here.
packs.pending.title: Waiting for approval
packs.overridden: {count, plural, =0 {No object changed by you} one {# object changed by you} other {# objects changed by you}}
packs.conflicts: {count, plural, =0 {No conflicts} one {# conflict from the last upgrade} other {# conflicts from the last upgrade}}
packs.retired: {count, plural, =0 {} one {# object left the pack} other {# objects left the pack}}
packs.updates.title: Newer versions
packs.confirm.install.title: Install {name}?
packs.confirm.install.body: The pack's objects are added to your set-up. Nothing you already have is overwritten: where you have an object of the same name, yours stays and the pack's value is listed.
packs.confirm.upgrade.title: Install version {version}?
packs.confirm.upgrade.body: Objects you have not changed take the new values; objects you changed keep your values and are listed with the pack's new value. New objects are added; objects the pack no longer holds are switched off, never deleted.
packs.confirm.take.title: Take the pack value?
packs.confirm.take.body: Your value of {key} is replaced by the pack's value. The change is recorded like any other change.
packs.reason.label: Reason (shown to the approver)
packs.done.installed: Installed: {added} added, {kept} kept as you had them.
packs.done.upgraded: Upgraded: {added} added, {updated} updated, {kept} kept as you had them, {retired} switched off.
packs.done.pending: Sent for approval. Nothing changes until a second person approves it.
packs.items.title: Objects of {name}
packs.items.loadError: The objects could not be loaded.
packs.items.empty: You have not changed any object of this pack.
packs.items.truncated: Only the first {shown} of {total} objects are shown.
packs.type.label: terms
